text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The dream I had on the night of the 
Satsuki Sho... It was that on the day of 
the Japanese Derby, heavy rain fell... and 
the turf turned rough."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ――This place isn't where we planned to be.
choice_data_list: I wanted to train on heavy turf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just to be safe, I looked for a spot 
similar to a heavy rain track to train on. 
This choice wasn't just because of the 
dream—
choice_data_list:
I want to minimize the weather's impact as 
much as possible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heavy track conditions are tough for 
Classic-class girls with little race 
experience. But with her proven talent, 
she can afford to prepare.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"If you're going to do it, do it grandly. 
Turn the course into a swamp."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the day of the Japanese Derby 
arrived—

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's pouring rain...! What the heck, 
this isn't a puddle, it's a pond!
choice_data_list:
(It's exactly the same as in the 
dream...!)

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text: Can she even... run properly like this?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey mister, did you just get here? I've 
been watching the races since this 
morning, and everyone's having a super 
rough time."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
W-What's up with this track...! It 
couldn't be harder to run on...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
If only it wasn't raining like this...! 
Ugh, it's so frustrating~!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
—*Sigh*, talk about a letdown... ...Maybe 
it really was too early for this. I just 
wanted to see it in person, but...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"...That news from this morning popped 
into my head. Having fun all by ourselves, 
it just feels so..."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
"...I wanted to feel that craze live in 
person, but not like this..."

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey... I was hoping a Triple Crown 
Umamusume might emerge from this 
situation, but looking at this, it's gonna 
be tough, huh?

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
Huh, why's that? Orfevre... do you dislike 
the rain?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"She seems rather temperamental... 
Wouldn't she struggle on heavy track 
conditions like this? The main race will 
be even more chewed up, too."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
"...I, see... ............I wonder if 
Orfevre's really... gonna stop too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The rain was eating away at people's 
hearts... And amidst all that, Orfevre—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Fuhahahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The King—simply roared with laughter.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: It's maddening.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Even the heavens weep tears of joy at our 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: These tears were dedicated to the king.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: For my sake, the heavens wept—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heaven's fortune favors me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Today's crown seems like it will be quite 
heavy."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My spine tingled. As the only one who 
claimed this rain was a gift from the 
heavens, she was truly... unlike any other 
girl.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
What are you spacing out for? We're 
leaving.
choice_data_list: ...You're free to run however you like.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As long as she brings out her true 
strength, the start, the positioning, the 
battle on the final straight... everything 
will work out. I'm certain of it.
choice_data_list: Everything will “become” just as you wish!

Everything shall “become” just as you 
desire!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Very well. You have only to revere me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The crown that everyone yearns for and 
seeks... A throne built upon the corpses 
of dreams—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh. Fitting for me indeed.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Rain... Ugh, I hate this... Still, I'm 
sure—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: —It's a blessing, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
For a gritty girl like me, this is the 
perfect stage...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The one walking the victory path today... 
is gonna be me!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: O heavens, weep.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: It is not enough. More... I need more...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"—Hah-hah-hah...! Ah... How utterly 
exhilarating."
